newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Clinton arrives in Sydney for Australia visit.
newsitem.headline: Clinton arrives in Sydney for Australia visit.

text.p: U.S. President Bill Clinton arrived in Sydney on Tuesday for a five-day Australian visit, his first overseas trip since his re-election.
Clinton, accompanied by his wife Hillary, touched down in his presidential jumbo jet to be greeted by Australian Prime Minister John Howard.
Clinton is the third serving U.S. president, after Lyndon Johnson and George Bush, to visit Australia -- a long-time ally of the United States.
Clinton will hold a one hour talk with Howard in the national capital Canberra on Wednesday, before addressing a joint sitting of both houses of parliament.
On Thursday, Clinton will make an open air address in Sydney's Botanic Gardens, while Hillary will address a gathering of high-powered women in the nearby Sydney Opera House.

Clinton also plans a round of golf with world number one Greg Norman in Sydney, before heading to the Great Barrier Reef for two days of sun, snorkelling and golf before heading to the the Philippines for next week's APEC summit.
